name: Huanjue Bingli
source:
You wake up as a doctor in a mental hospital, entangled with three suspicious "patients" who appear by your side. Little by little, your past and memories are revealed...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595050/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你醒来时是一家精神病院的医生，与出现在你身边的三名可疑的“病人”纠缠在一起。你的过去和记忆一点一点地被揭开……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595050/_/]Steam[/url]]
